$comment: SDD factory runtime configuration for this repository. Policy for the orchestrator, not rules for the code: rules live in docs/constitution.md. Later replaced by the control plane.

approvals.$comment: Human approval gates the orchestrator may grant on its own when the artifact is verifiably clean: Intake, Spec, Design, Task, Final. A Constitution issue is never merged without a human.

reviewers.$comment: Intelligence FLOOR of the Review Gate agents by issue type (wins) or triage size. In mode auto the reviewers are raised one tier from the second review cycle on, and to strong on the last permitted cycle.

intelligence.$comment: Intelligence FLOORS per phase (light | standard | strong | frontier; a phase may map by triage size {S, M, L, default}). With mode 'auto' the orchestrator may raise a phase above its floor (rework, last permitted review cycle, recent failures of that phase) and never below; 'fixed' uses the floors as-is. Spec and design have a strong floor: their errors are the most expensive to detect. 'frontier' is the best model available and is reached only through an explicit floor, never by automatic raises.
